verses.text: Moses gather all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel together, and talk to dem, “Dis na di things wey di Lord don command, make una do dem.
Six days work go dey done, but on di seventh day una go get one holy day, one Sabbath of solemn rest to di Lord. Whoever do any work on am go dey put to death.
Una no go kindle fire for una dwellings on di Sabbath day.”
Moses speak to all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, talk, “Dis na di thing wey di Lord command, talk,
‘Take from among una one offering to di Lord. Whoever get willing heart, make am bring am, di Lord offering: gold, silver, bronze,
blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats hair,
rams skins dyed red, hides of sea cows, acacia wood,
oil for di light, spices for di anointing oil and for di sweet incense,
onyx stones, and stones to set for di ephod and for di breastplate.
Make every wise hearted man among una come, and make all wey di Lord don command:
di tabernacle, im tent, and im covering, im clasps, and im boards, im bars, im pillars, and im sockets,
di ark and im poles, di mercy seat, and di veil of di screen,
di table with im poles and all im vessels, and di bread of presence,
di lampstand for di light with im vessels, and im lamps, and di oil for di light,
and di altar of incense with im poles, and di anointing oil, and di sweet incense, and di screen for di door, for di entrance of di tabernacle,
di altar of burnt offering with im grating of bronze, im poles, and all im vessels, di basin and im base,
di hangings of di court, im pillars, and dem sockets, and di screen for di gate of di court,
di pegs of di tabernacle, and di pegs of di court, and dem cords,
di finely worked garments, for ministering for di holy place, di holy garments for Aaron di priest, and di garments of im pikin man dem, to minister for di priest office.’”
All di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel depart from di presence of Moses.

Dem come, everyone whose heart stir am up, and everyone whose spirit make am willing, and dem bring di Lord offering for di work of di Tent of Meeting, and for all im service, and for di holy garments.
Dem come, both men and women, as many as get willing heart, and bring brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold, even every man wey offer one offering of gold to di Lord.
Every man wey get blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats hair, rams skins dyed red, and hides of sea cows, bring dem.
Everyone wey offer one offering of silver and bronze bring di Lord offering. Everyone wey get acacia wood for any work of di service bring am.
All di women wey dey wise hearted spin with dem hands, and bring wetin dem don spin, di blue, di purple, di scarlet, and di fine linen.
All di women whose heart stir dem up for wisdom spin di goats hair.
Di rulers bring onyx stones, and stones to set, for di ephod and for di breastplate,
and di spice, and di oil, for di light, and for di anointing oil, and for di sweet incense.
Di pikin dem of Israel bring one willing offering to di Lord, every man and woman whose heart make dem willing to bring for all di work wey di Lord command to dey made by Moses.
Moses talk to di pikin dem of Israel, “Look, di Lord don call by name Bezalel di pikin of Uri, di pikin of Hur, of di tribe of Judah.
E don fill am with God Spirit, for wisdom, for understanding, for knowledge, and for all kinds of workmanship,
to devise skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
and for cutting of stones for setting, and for carving of wood, to work for all kinds of skillful workmanship.
E don put am for im heart to teach, both am and Oholiab, di pikin of Ahisamach, of di tribe of Dan.

E don fill dem with wisdom of heart, to work all kinds of workmanship, of di engraver, and of di skillful workman, and of di embroiderer, for blue, for purple, for scarlet, and for fine linen, and of di weaver, even of dem wey do any workmanship, and of dem wey devise skillful works.

Bezalel and Oholiab go work, and every wise hearted man, wey di Lord don put wisdom and understanding inside, to know how to do all di work for di service of di sanctuary, according to all wey di Lord don command.”
Moses call Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart di Lord don put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stir am up to come to di work to do am.
Dem receive from Moses all di offering wey di pikin dem of Israel don bring for di work of di service of di sanctuary, to make am. Dem still dey bring am free will offerings every morning.
All di wise men, wey dey do all di work of di sanctuary, come, every man from im work wey dem dey do,
and dem speak to Moses, talk, “Di people bring much more than enough for di service of di work wey di Lord command to make.”

Moses give commandment, and dem cause am to dey proclaimed throughout di camp, talk, “Make neither man nor woman make any more work for di offering of di sanctuary.” So di people dey restrained from bringing.
Because di stuff wey dem get dey sufficient for all di work to make am, and too much.

All di wise hearted men among dem wey do di work make di tabernacle with ten curtains. Of fine twined linen, and blue, purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, di work of one skillful workman, dem make dem.
Di length of one curtain na 28 cubits, and di width of one curtain four cubits. All di curtains get one measure.
E couple five curtains one to another, and di other five curtains e couple one to another.
E make loops of blue on di edge of one curtain from di edge for di coupling. Na so e make for di edge of di outermost curtain for di second coupling.
E make 50 loops for di one curtain, and e make 50 loops for di edge of di curtain wey dey di second coupling. Di loops dey opposite one to another.
E make 50 clasps of gold, and couple di curtains one to another with di clasps, so that di tabernacle become one.
E make curtains of goats hair for one tent over di tabernacle. E make 11 curtains.
Di length of one curtain na 30 cubits, and four cubits di width of one curtain. Di 11 curtains get one measure.
E couple five curtains by demself, and six curtains by demself.
E make 50 loops on di edge of di outermost curtain for di coupling, and 50 loops make e for di edge of di curtain wey join di second coupling.
E make 50 clasps of bronze to couple di tent together, so that e go be one.
E make one covering for di tent of rams skins dyed red, and one covering of hides of sea cows above.
E make di boards for di tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
Ten cubits na di length of one board, and one and half cubits di width of one board.
One board get two tenons, joined one to another. Na so e make for all di boards of di tabernacle.
E make di boards for di tabernacle: 20 boards for di south side toward di south.
E make 40 sockets of silver under di 20 boards, two sockets under one board for im two tenons, and two sockets under another board for im two tenons.
For di second side of di tabernacle, on di north side, e make 20 boards,
and dem 40 sockets of silver, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
For di back of di tabernacle toward di west e make six boards.
E make two boards for di corners of di tabernacle for di back.
Dem dey double beneath, and together dem dey complete to di top of am to one ring. Na so e do to dem both for di two corners.
Dere dey eight boards, and dem sockets of silver, 16 sockets, under every board two sockets.
E make bars of acacia wood: five for di boards of di one side of di tabernacle,
and five bars for di boards of di other side of di tabernacle, and five bars for di boards of di tabernacle for di back toward di west.
E make di middle bar to pass through di middle of di boards from di one end to di other.
E overlay di boards with gold, and make dem rings of gold to be places for di bars, and overlay di bars with gold.
E make di veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. E make am with cherubim, di work of one skillful workman.
E make for am four pillars of acacia, and overlay dem with gold. Dem hooks na gold. E cast for dem four sockets of silver.
E make one screen for di door of di tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, di work of one embroiderer,
and di five pillars of am with dem hooks. E overlay dem tops and dem fillets with gold, and dem five sockets na bronze.
Bezalel make di ark of acacia wood. Im length na two and half cubits, im width one and half cubits, and im height one and half cubits.
E overlay am with pure gold inside and outside, and make one moulding of gold round about am.
E cast for am four rings of gold, for im four feet, two rings on di one side of am, and two rings on di other side of am.
E make poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold.
E put di poles into di rings on di sides of di ark, to carry di ark.
E make one mercy seat of pure gold. Im length na two and half cubits, and im width one and half cubits.
E make two cherubim of gold. E make dem of beaten work, for di two ends of di mercy seat,
one cherub for di one end, and one cherub for di other end. Of di mercy seat e make di cherubim on im two ends.
Di cherubim spread out dem wings on high, covering di mercy seat with dem wings, with dem faces toward each other. Di faces of di cherubim dey toward di mercy seat.
E make di table of acacia wood. Im length na two cubits, im width one cubit, and im height one and half cubits.
E overlay am with pure gold, and make for am one moulding of gold round about.
E make for am one border of one handbreadth round about, and make one golden moulding for im border round about.
E cast for am four rings of gold, and put di rings for di four corners wey dey im four feet.
Di rings dey close to di border, as places for di poles to carry di table.
E make di poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold, to carry di table.
E make di vessels wey dey upon di table, im dishes, im spoons, im bowls, and im pitchers, wey dem go use pour out, of pure gold.
E make di lampstand of pure gold. Of beaten work e make di lampstand, im base, and im shaft. Im cups, im buds, and im flowers dey of di same piece with am.
Six branches go out of im sides: three branches of di lampstand out of di one side of am, and three branches of di lampstand out of di other side of am.

Three cups made like almond blossoms, each with bud and flower, for di one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with bud and flower, for di other branch. So for di six branches wey go out of di lampstand.
For di lampstand na four cups made like almond blossoms, with dem buds and dem flowers,
and one bud under di first pair of branches of am, and one bud under di second pair of branches of am, and one bud under di third pair of branches of am, for di six branches wey go out of am.
Dem buds and dem branches dey of di same piece with am. All of am na one beaten work of pure gold.
E make im seven lamps, and im snuffers, and im trays, of pure gold.
Of one talent of pure gold e make am, and all im vessels.
E make di altar of incense of acacia wood. Im length na one cubit, and im width one cubit, square, and im height two cubits. Im horns dey of one piece with am.
E overlay am with pure gold, di top of am, and im sides round about, and im horns. E make for am one moulding of gold round about.
E make for am two golden rings under im moulding, upon im two sides, upon di two sides of am, as places for poles to carry am with.
E make di poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold.
E make di holy anointing oil, and di pure incense of sweet spices, di work of di perfumer.
E make di altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. Im length na five cubits, and im width five cubits, square, and im height three cubits.
E make im horns on im four corners. Im horns dey of one piece with am, and e overlay am with bronze.
E make all di vessels of di altar, di pots, di shovels, di basins, di forks, and di fire pans. All im vessels e make of bronze.
E make for di altar one grating of network of bronze, under di ledge round am, halfway up.
E cast four rings for di four ends of di grating of bronze, to be places for di poles.
E make di poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with bronze.
E put di poles into di rings on di sides of di altar, to carry am with dem. E make am hollow with boards.
E make di basin of bronze, with im base of bronze, from di mirrors of di serving women wey serve for di door of di Tent of Meeting.
E make di court. For di south side toward di south, di hangings of di court na fine twined linen, 100 cubits.
Dem pillars na 20, and dem sockets 20, of bronze. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets na silver.
For di north side na 100 cubits. Dem pillars na 20, and dem sockets 20, of bronze. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets na silver.
For di west side na hangings of 50 cubits, dem pillars ten, and dem sockets ten. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets na silver.
For di east side toward di sunrise na 50 cubits.
Di hangings for di one side of di gate na 15 cubits, dem pillars three, and dem sockets three.
Na so for di other side. On di one hand and on di other hand of di gate of di court na hangings of 15 cubits, dem pillars three, and dem sockets three.
All di hangings round di court na fine twined linen.
Di sockets for di pillars na bronze. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets na silver, and di overlaying of dem tops na silver. All di pillars of di court dey filleted with silver.

Di screen for di gate of di court na di work of one embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Di length na 20 cubits, and di height for di width na five cubits, like di hangings of di court.
Dem pillars na four, and dem sockets of bronze four. Dem hooks na silver, and di overlaying of dem tops and dem fillets na silver.
All di pegs of di tabernacle, and of di court round about, na bronze.

Dis na di numbers of di things of di tabernacle, even of di tabernacle of di testimony, as dem dey counted, according to di commandment of Moses, for di service of di Levites, by di hand of Ithamar, Aaron pikin, di priest.
Bezalel di pikin of Uri, di pikin of Hur, of di tribe of Judah, make all wey di Lord command Moses.
With am dey Oholiab, di pikin of Ahisamach, of di tribe of Dan, one engraver, and one skillful workman, and one embroiderer for blue, for purple, for scarlet, and for fine linen.
All di gold wey dem use for di work for all di work of di sanctuary, even di gold of di offering, na 29 talents, and 730 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary.
Di silver of dem wey dey numbered of di congregation na 100 talents, and 1,775 shekels, after di shekel of di sanctuary,
one beka for one head, wey be half shekel, after di shekel of di sanctuary, for everyone wey pass over to dem wey dey numbered, from 20 years old and above, for 603,550 men.
Di 100 talents of silver dey for casting di sockets of di sanctuary, and di sockets of di veil: 100 sockets for di 100 talents, one talent for one socket.
Of di 1,775 shekels e make hooks for di pillars, and overlay dem tops, and fillet dem.
Di bronze of di offering na 70 talents, and 2,400 shekels.
With am e make di sockets to di door of di Tent of Meeting, and di bronze altar, and di bronze grating for am, and all di vessels of di altar,
and di sockets of di court round about, and di sockets of di gate of di court, and all di pegs of di tabernacle, and all di pegs of di court round about.
Of di blue, purple, and scarlet dem make finely worked garments, for ministering for di holy place, and dem make di holy garments for Aaron, as di Lord command Moses.
E make di ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Dem beat di gold into thin plates, and cut am into wires, to work am into di blue, di purple, di scarlet, and di fine linen, with skillful work.
Dem make shoulder pieces for am, joined together. For im two ends e dey joined together.
Di skillfully woven band wey dey on am, to fasten am on, na of di same piece, according to im work: of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as di Lord command Moses.
Dem work di onyx stones, enclosed for settings of gold, engraved with di engravings of one signet, according to di names of di pikin dem of Israel.
E put dem on di shoulder pieces of di ephod, to be stones of memorial for di pikin dem of Israel, as di Lord command Moses.
E make di breastplate, di work of one skillful workman, like di work of di ephod: of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
E dey square. Dem make di breastplate double. One span im length, and one span im width, when e dey doubled.
Dem set for am four rows of stones. One row of sardius, topaz, and emerald na di first row.
Di second row, one turquoise, one sapphire, and one diamond.
Di third row, one jacinth, one agate, and one amethyst.
Di fourth row, one beryl, one onyx, and one jasper. Dem dey enclosed for settings of gold for dem enclosings.
Di stones dey according to di names of di pikin dem of Israel, 12, according to dem names, like di engravings of one signet, everyone according to im name, for di 12 tribes.
Dem make on di breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
Dem make two settings of gold, and two rings of gold, and put di two rings on di two ends of di breastplate.
Dem put di two braided chains of gold for di two rings for di ends of di breastplate.
Di other two ends of di two braided chains dem fasten for di two settings, and put dem on di shoulder pieces of di ephod for im front.
Dem make two rings of gold, and put dem on di two ends of di breastplate, upon im edge, wey dey toward di inside of di ephod.
Dem make two rings of gold, and put dem on di two shoulder pieces of di ephod underneath, toward im front, close to im coupling, above di skillfully woven band of di ephod.

Dem bind di breastplate by im rings to di rings of di ephod with one lace of blue, so that e go dey above di skillfully woven band of di ephod, and so that di breastplate no go come loose from di ephod, as di Lord command Moses.
E make di robe of di ephod of woven work, all of blue.
Di opening of di robe dey for di middle of am, like di opening of one coat of mail, with one binding round di opening of am, so that e no go tear.
Dem make on di hem of di robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
Dem make bells of pure gold, and put di bells between di pomegranates on di hem of di robe round about, between di pomegranates:
one bell and one pomegranate, one bell and one pomegranate, on di hem of di robe round about, to minister in, as di Lord command Moses.
Dem make di coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for im pikin man dem,
and di turban of fine linen, and di headbands of fine linen, and di linen trousers of fine twined linen,
and di sash of fine twined linen, and blue, purple, and scarlet, di work of one embroiderer, as di Lord command Moses.
Dem make di plate of di holy crown of pure gold, and write on am, like di engravings of one signet, “HOLY TO DI LORD.”
Dem tie to am one lace of blue, to fasten am on high upon di turban, as di Lord command Moses.
Na so all di work of di tabernacle of di Tent of Meeting dey finished. Di pikin dem of Israel do according to all wey di Lord command Moses. Na so dem do.
Dem bring di tabernacle to Moses, di tent, and all im furnishings, im clasps, im boards, im bars, and im pillars, and im sockets,
and di covering of rams skins dyed red, and di covering of hides of sea cows, and di veil of di screen,
di ark of di testimony, and im poles, and di mercy seat,
di table, all im vessels, and di bread of presence,
di pure lampstand, with im lamps, even di lamps wey dey set in order, and all im vessels, and di oil for light,
and di golden altar, and di anointing oil, and di sweet incense, and di screen for di door of di tent,
di bronze altar, and im grating of bronze, im poles, and all im vessels, di basin and im base,
di hangings of di court, im pillars, and dem sockets, and di screen for di gate of di court, im cords, and im pegs, and all di vessels of di service of di tabernacle, for di Tent of Meeting,
di finely worked garments for ministering for di holy place, and di holy garments for Aaron di priest, and di garments of im pikin man dem, to minister for di priest office.
According to all wey di Lord command Moses, so di pikin dem of Israel make all di work.
Moses see all di work, and look, dem don do am as di Lord command. Na so dem do am. Moses bless dem.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“On di first day of di first month you go set up di tabernacle of di Tent of Meeting.
You go put dere di ark of di testimony, and you go screen di ark with di veil.
You go bring in di table, and set in order di things wey dey on am. You go bring in di lampstand, and light im lamps.
You go set di golden altar for incense before di ark of di testimony, and put di screen of di door to di tabernacle.
You go set di altar of burnt offering before di door of di tabernacle of di Tent of Meeting.
You go set di basin between di Tent of Meeting and di altar, and put water inside am.
You go set up di court round about, and hang up di screen of di gate of di court.
You go take di anointing oil, and anoint di tabernacle, and all wey dey inside am, and make am holy, and all im furnishings. E go dey holy.
You go anoint di altar of burnt offering, and all im vessels, and make di altar holy. Di altar go be most holy.
You go anoint di basin and im base, and make am holy.
You go bring Aaron and im pikin man dem to di door of di Tent of Meeting, and wash dem with water.
You go put upon Aaron di holy garments. You go anoint am, and make am holy, so that e go minister to me for di priest office.
You go bring im pikin man dem, and put coats on dem.
You go anoint dem, as you anoint dem papa, so that dem go minister to me for di priest office. Dem anointing go surely be for one everlasting priesthood throughout dem generations.”
Moses do according to all wey di Lord command am. Na so e do.
E come be say for di first month for di second year, on di first day of di month, dem set up di tabernacle.
Moses set up di tabernacle, and lay im sockets, and set up im boards, and put in im bars, and set up im pillars.
E spread di tent over di tabernacle, and put di covering of di tent above on top of am, as di Lord command Moses.
E take and put di testimony into di ark, and set di poles on di ark, and put di mercy seat above on top of di ark.
E bring di ark into di tabernacle, and set up di veil of di screen, and screen di ark of di testimony, as di Lord command Moses.
E put di table for di Tent of Meeting, upon di side of di tabernacle toward di north, outside di veil.
E set di bread in order upon am before di Lord, as di Lord command Moses.
E put di lampstand for di Tent of Meeting, opposite di table, on di side of di tabernacle toward di south.
E light di lamps before di Lord, as di Lord command Moses.
E put di golden altar for di Tent of Meeting before di veil,
and e burn on am sweet incense, as di Lord command Moses.
E put up di screen of di door to di tabernacle.
E set di altar of burnt offering by di door of di tabernacle of di Tent of Meeting, and offer on am di burnt offering and di meal offering, as di Lord command Moses.
E set di basin between di Tent of Meeting and di altar, and put water dere, to wash with.
Moses and Aaron and im pikin man dem wash dem hands and dem feet dere.
When dem go into di Tent of Meeting, and when dem come near to di altar, dem wash, as di Lord command Moses.
E set up di court round about di tabernacle and di altar, and hang up di screen of di gate of di court. So Moses finish di work.
Di cloud cover di Tent of Meeting, and di glory of di Lord fill di tabernacle.
Moses no fit enter into di Tent of Meeting, because di cloud stay on top of am, and di glory of di Lord fill di tabernacle.
When di cloud dey taken up from over di tabernacle, di pikin dem of Israel go onward, for all dem journeys.
But if di cloud no dey taken up, dem no journey until di day wey e dey taken up.
Because di cloud of di Lord dey on di tabernacle by day, and fire dey on am by night, for di sight of all di house of Israel, throughout all dem journeys.
